conclusions: M3AX accuracy 1.0 shows the region-grid true TCN path can memorize a tiny subset, so M3AW failure is not explained by a total model-input or optimizer-path break.

M3AW held-out predictions collapsed to 3 validation labels and 3 test labels; labels never predicted include validation ['please', 'sad', 'table', 'white'] and test ['please', 'sad', 'table', 'white'].
Confidence stayed weak: validation mean confidence 0.1950, test mean confidence 0.1949, selected threshold 0.23.
Train/held-out signer overlap is limited: train-validation overlap [], train-test overlap []. This supports a signer/split generalization diagnosis.

Hand-engineered crop-stat centroids show same-label held-out drift losing to another train label for 10 split-label rows: ['validation:table', 'validation:please', 'validation:hello', 'validation:white', 'validation:sad', 'test:please', 'test:black', 'test:hello', 'test:uncle', 'test:sad'].
M3AW receipt status `completed_smoke_target_failed` and M3AX receipt status `tiny_overfit_succeeded` must remain separate: tiny memorization is not browser readiness or held-out success.

descriptive_feature_separation.feature_definition: For each of five fixed regions: mean intensity, std intensity, temporal mean absolute frame difference, normalized by 255. Descriptive only; no model fitting.

guardrails.non_promotion: This diagnosis is not training, calibration, export, browser activation, final readiness, or a claim that the M3AW recognizer generalizes.

m3ax_tiny_subset_representativeness.interpretation: The tiny subset is one deterministic clip per label and is useful for model/input memorization only. Its per-label percentile statistics are descriptive and do not prove held-out representativeness.
m3ax_tiny_subset_representativeness.selection_rule: sort labels lexicographically, sort clips within each label by clip_id, select first clips_per_label

method.description: Loaded existing JSON artifacts and existing region-grid tensors, verified tensor hashes, computed deterministic descriptive crop statistics and prediction summaries only.
